edgeCasesMissed: There is no browser-level standard-build test that preloads e2e-like query parameters, localStorage keys, or a forged window.__og_e2e value and verifies the application neither installs nor upgrades it; production JavaScript artifact inspection and the compile-time-only mode equality establish non-activation statically.

The artifact regression test covers explicit production mode but not named staging, test, or development builds; adversarial builds of all three alternate modes were scanned during validation and contained none of the bridge markers.
topFinding: No production activation path was found: __OG_E2E__ is replaced solely from the build-time equality mode === 'e2e', standard and alternate non-e2e JavaScript artifacts contain neither the global marker nor mutation commands, and identity-checked cleanup cannot delete a replacement bridge after remount.

impact.rationale: The standard build and 52-unit-test suite pass, bridge contract and replacement ownership tests pass, and alternate development/staging/test production builds exclude instrumentation. Remaining findings are missing automated browser assertions, not observed runtime or security defects.
